page.layout: One page, all lines centred: the title block at the top, a verse quotation in smaller italic below it, a woodcut device with a scroll motto in the middle, and the imprint at the foot. No running head, no page number, no marginal text. A pencilled letter on the left margin is handwriting and is left out.

l.i: Surge Deus, judica terram; quoniam tu haredi-

page.notes: The woodcut device shows an eagle on a rock with a scroll; the motto on the scroll is transcribed above. The scroll wording is partly cut off at the edges. "haredi-" is read from the scan as printed and is not certain; the printer's form may be haeredi-. The long s in "possidebis" is read as ss. "Joan." follows the j/i rule for the consonant I of Ioannis. The date reads cIↄ Iↄ c XVIII, i.e. MDCXVIII. Pencilled letter on the left margin is not printed and is left out.
